Live me drawdown aksar backtest se bada aata hai. 😬

Spread, slippage aur badalta market backtest me poora nahi aata. Control ka sabse bada hathiyaar position size hai: 10% risk pe 5 lagataar haar = lagbhag 40% neeche, 1% pe wahi 5 haar = lagbhag 5%.
